name: 大唐西游
english_name: Great Tang Journey to the West (dtxy)
english_description: A GitHub mirror of the same 'Great Tang Journey to the West' codebase already preserved in this project as dtxywzxzb -- an artificial-human/NPC-themed Journey to the West lineage MUD whose domain directory list (12gong, 33tian, changan, emei, kunlun, shushan, ...) is essentially identical to dtxywzxzb's, differing only by one extra stray file and one extra domain directory. No separate build was produced; see dtxywzxzb for the live, playable instance and its full fix catalog.
